meta.notes: Second scan, run a day late. Copenhagen had more English-language comms roles this week, including a French and English events job. Two roles from last week have closed and were taken off.

health.notes: Denmark with experience filter, Vancouver, Canada, Australia, New Zealand. Danish internships much reduced by the filter.

jobs.title: Promotion & Event Officer for Denmark, Norway, Finland and the Baltic countries
jobs.notes: French and English are the core requirement and basic Scandinavian is enough, so your French is the edge here and your Danish already qualifies. Events, roadshows, newsletters and partnerships promoting France as a destination, with about 20 travel days a year. Lead with CPH:DOX and your event work. Listed as temporary on Jobindex, so ask about contract length. Apply by 15 Nov, start 1 Jan 2027.

jobs.title: Video Producer Specialist
jobs.notes: Hands-on in-house video production at a Copenhagen sports tech scaleup, and Danish is only a plus. Asks for 3+ years of video production, which your VELUX LinkedIn video work and your films cover. On-site rather than hybrid. 43 applicants so far.

jobs.title: Content and Communications Specialist
jobs.notes: Content strategy and comms for UBC's international student recruitment, in Vancouver, with pay well above your floor. Lead with your corporate copy and video work at VELUX plus your own experience as an international student in Canada and Denmark. Over 100 people have clicked apply, so send it soon.

jobs.title: Communication Coordinator (1 year fixed term)
jobs.notes: English-language comms role for Danfoss's service business, close in shape to your VELUX job. Fixed term for one year and listed as on-site. Over 100 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: PR Manager (Maternity Cover)
jobs.notes: Design brand, English-language ad, storytelling, press and influencer partnerships, start Jan or Feb 2027. Gap: asks for proven PR Manager experience in design or lifestyle; your VELUX press site work across 22 countries is the angle. Maternity cover. Apply by 18 Nov.

jobs.title: Content & Campaign Lead
jobs.notes: Content and campaigns for a Copenhagen digital commerce consultancy, asking for 2 to 3 years in content or B2B marketing, which you have. B2B focus rather than your preferred sectors, and on-site.

jobs.title: Senior Multimedia Specialist
jobs.notes: Public-sector storytelling through video and multimedia for the regional government, a direct use of your filmmaking. Senior level and includes directing contractors, so it is a stretch on years. Over 100 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Outreach and Community Engagement Officer
jobs.notes: Science faculty outreach and community engagement, hybrid, good pay. Fits your event organising and facilitation (Humanity in Action, ANIMOK) more than your video work. Posted yesterday.

jobs.title: Communications and Project Officer (Bilingual)
jobs.notes: Bilingual English and French comms and project role in the research library world, where your French and research background both count. 13-month contract and Ottawa rather than Vancouver. Apply by 20 Nov.

jobs.title: Communications Specialist
jobs.notes: Comms at one of Canada's larger art museums, squarely in your cultural-sector track. Calgary rather than Vancouver, and a 12-month term. Apply by email (careers@glenbow.org) by 5 Nov.

jobs.title: Communications Specialist
jobs.company: Chartered Professional Accountants of British Columbia
jobs.notes: Vancouver comms role in the Brand Creative team, hybrid, with a stated salary. A professional body for accountants, not a bank, but not a purpose-led sector either. LinkedIn lists it as a contract.

jobs.title: Content Producer
jobs.notes: Content production for an industry body with a sustainability and farming communities angle, hybrid, posted today with almost no applicants yet. Check work rights for Australia.

jobs.title: Content Producer, Alumni & Advancement
jobs.notes: New university content producer role telling alumni and donor stories, good pay. Two-year fixed term in Adelaide. Check work rights for Australia.

jobs.title: Communications Advisor
jobs.notes: Municipal comms role near Wellington in the Communication, Engagement and Marketing team, hybrid, posted yesterday with one applicant so far. Check work rights for New Zealand.

jobs.title: Yoga Teacher at a surf camp
jobs.notes: Paid yoga teaching with a room and meals, rolling intake for 2026 and 2027, which is what you asked for. Pay and hours are not published, so ask. Needs a yoga qualification and 3+ months of teaching, which you have.

jobs.title: Yoga Instructor, Full Season
jobs.salary: Paid monthly wage, plus tent and meals
jobs.notes: Paid seasonal role with food and a tent on camp, June to September 2027, so a summer option rather than now. Needs a 200-hour teacher training. Spanish preferred, where your intermediate Spanish helps.
